translations.changes: Amudi placed existing CC0 English passages next to uniquely corroborated Hebrew-Aramaic passages. Multiple non-overlapping English excerpts for one paragraph are grouped and labeled as partial translations. Translations spanning adjacent paragraphs are labeled with their passage numbers.
